title: Question 6 photograph
passage:
A. The back of the frame is facing up, and both hands are holding the same side of the frame.
B. The frame is being held above the table with the glass facing up.
C. The back of the frame is facing up, and a photograph is partly underneath it.
D. The frame is being held with its back facing up, and a photograph lies beside it.
passageZh:
A. 相框的背面朝上，雙手握在相框的同一側。
B. 有人把相框舉在桌面上方，玻璃面朝上。
C. 相框的背面朝上，有張照片的一部分在相框下方。
D. 有人拿著相框，讓背面朝上，旁邊平放著一張照片。
audioScript:
